newsitem.title: UK: Sedgwick offers Lloyd's data on disk.
newsitem.headline: Sedgwick offers Lloyd's data on disk.

text.p: UK insurance broker Sedgwick Group Plc said on Monday it will this week launch Lloyd's Limelight guide to the insurance market on computer disk.

The Limelight database on disk contains all the information on underwriting syndicates available in the earlier printed versions, but in a computer-searchable format, Sedgwick's Tony Law told Reuters.
Lloyd's will not be producing the market guide in book form anymore, although the disk comes with a hard-copy version.
Several organisations sell printed annual guides to the Lloyd's market which include accounts for the 170 or so underwriting syndicates.
Law said the Sedgwick version of Limelight is the only one which can be searched on a computer, allowing users to manipulate the data.
Limelight on disk costs 276 stg or $431.
